verdict.rationale: Hightouch lets data engineers define models via SQL, dbt, or a visual builder to filter/transform data before syncing to destinations, and syncs map fields between source and destination (hightouch-docs-2, hightouch-docs-23, hightouch-docs-47, hightouch-docs-48). However, there is no evidence of dedicated custom-code/function-based transformation or enrichment steps (e.g., JS/Python functions) applied in-pipeline beyond SQL modeling and simple field mapping. missing for 10: documentation of custom code/function-based enrichment (e.g., JS/Python transform steps), examples of enrichment logic beyond SQL models, independent corroboration of this specific capability.
